verdict.rationale: Canva is a SaaS platform with developer APIs (Connect REST APIs, Apps SDK, MCP server), so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question to ask. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a sandbox, test, or staging environment isolated from production data. Team and private app distribution controls who can use an app; they are not data isolation, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
